title: BioTek Synergy H1 hybrid plate reader
manualMd: Multi-mode plate reader: absorbance (200-999 nm), fluorescence intensity, and luminescence. Reads 6-, 24-, 96-, 384-well plates. Software: Gen5.
hazardsMd:
- Lamp uses high voltage; never open the case while powered.
- Plates with volatiles (DMSO, methanol) can evaporate and contaminate the optics — seal with breathable seal or run quickly.

operations.title: Daily startup
operations.bodyMd: Power on the unit, then launch Gen5. Wait for self-test (~2 min). Confirm 'No errors' on the status panel.

operations.title: OD600 bacterial growth
operations.bodyMd: Use a clear-bottom 96-well plate. Read at 600 nm absorbance. Subtract a media-only blank from each well. For accurate doubling-time fits, set the timepoint interval at 5 min for fast-growers, 15 min for slow.

operations.title: Reading drifts upward over time
operations.bodyMd: Usually condensation on the plate lid as it warms inside the chamber. Switch to lid-off + breathable seal, or pre-equilibrate the plate at 37 °C for 10 min.

operations.title: Lamp won't ignite
operations.bodyMd: Lamp may be at end-of-life (typical 2000 hours). Check the Gen5 maintenance log; replace per manufacturer instructions.

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd: Eject the plate carrier. Wipe any spilled liquid from the carrier. Close Gen5. Power off the reader if you're the last user of the day.
